summary_zh: 泰國工業部公布11月查出512家工廠違規，總理亦赴巴吞府查核工業廢棄物，發現工廠違令重啟機器，環保與工廠稽查壓力持續升高。同時泰英FTA談判框架加速推進、副總理推動汽車零件與電子業進入日本供應鏈，出口機會擴大，但泰美ART協議可能加劇進口競爭。
summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry found 512 factory violations in November, and the PM inspected industrial waste in Pathum Thani, tightening compliance pressure. Meanwhile Thai-UK FTA talks and a push into Japanese supply chains widen export chances, while the Thai-US ART deal may intensify import competition.
